title: Messages API idempotency keys
description: Messages API added idempotency key support to safely retry requests without duplicate completions in flaky network conditions.

title: Usage and cost export endpoints
description: New billing export endpoints enabled per-workspace usage CSV/JSON downloads and granular attribution by key, model, and project.

title: Prompt caching analytics
description: Prompt caching metrics became visible in API responses and dashboard analytics, including hit rate, cache-token savings, and effective latency deltas.

title: Structured outputs GA
whatChanged: API responses can follow a JSON schema you provide, with validation enforced server-side.
description: Structured JSON outputs and strict tool-use schema validation became generally available on the Claude API.

prerequisites: JSON Schema for your output shape
steps: Define the `output_format` (or equivalent) with your JSON Schema in the request.
Send the user/tool messages as usual; parse the model output as validated JSON.
Handle schema errors from the API like other request validation failures.

title: Adaptive thinking
description: New `thinking: {type: "adaptive"}` mode lets Claude dynamically decide when and how much to think based on task complexity. Recommended mode for Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6.

title: Claude Haiku 4.5 on the Claude API
description: Claude Haiku 4.5 (claude-haiku-4-5) became available on the Claude API at $0.25/$1.25 per MTok with 200k context, function-calling parity with Sonnet 4.6, and a recommended subagent profile.

title: Skills API public beta
description: The Skills API entered public beta as a way to package prompts, tools, and files into a single named skill. Use the skills-2026-02-09 beta header to attach skills to any Messages API call.

title: Compaction API beta
description: Anthropic launched server-side compaction for managing long-running conversations, activated with the `compact-2026-01-12` beta header.

title: Data residency controls
description: Developers gained control over where supported model inference runs via the `inference_geo` parameter (`"us"` or `"global"`).

title: Web search tool GA
description: The web search tool graduated from beta and no longer required a beta header. Web search and web fetch gained dynamic filtering to reduce token cost.

title: Programmatic tool calling GA
description: Claude gained first-class support for code that can invoke tools programmatically inside tool-enabled flows.

title: Automatic prompt caching for the Messages API
description: Messages API caching gained automatic cache point movement as conversations grow — no manual cache-break management needed.

title: Files API GA
description: The Claude Files API graduated from beta with stable endpoints for upload, retrieve, list, and delete; per-organization storage quotas; and a new content-class field for routing PDFs, spreadsheets, and images.

title: Tier 5 rate limits for high-throughput accounts
description: Claude Platform introduced a Tier 5 rate-limit class for verified high-throughput accounts, with 4M input tokens / minute on Sonnet 4.6 and 2M / minute on Opus 4.6.

title: 1M token context window GA for Claude 4.6
description: Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 gained a generally available 1M token context window.

title: MCP 1.1 spec adopted by the Claude API
description: The Claude API adopted the MCP 1.1 specification with negotiated authorization, capability discovery, and an OpenAPI-style schema export, plus a documented migration path from MCP 1.0 servers.

title: Fine-grained tool streaming GA
description: Streams tool-use parameter values without buffering or JSON validation, reducing latency for large parameters. No beta header required on any model.

title: Thinking display control
description: Extended thinking added the `display` field for summarized or omitted thinking output.

title: Models API capability fields
description: Models API responses started exposing capability metadata and token limits directly, removing the need to hardcode per-model limits.

title: Claude Evals platform GA
description: Anthropic released the Claude Evals platform GA: a hosted evaluation runner with versioned datasets, model and prompt comparisons, regression alerts, and an Evals API behind /v1/evals.

title: AWS PrivateLink and GCP Private Service Connect
description: Claude Platform added AWS PrivateLink and GCP Private Service Connect support for Enterprise customers in us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-west-1, and us-central1, eliminating public internet egress for API calls.

title: Message Batches max_tokens raised to 300k
description: The Message Batches API raised its `max_tokens` cap for Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6.

title: Advisor tool public beta
description: Pair a fast executor model with a high-intelligence advisor model for strategic mid-generation guidance on long-horizon agentic workloads. Requires `advisor-tool-2026-03-01` beta header.

title: Computer use tool 2.0 GA
description: The computer use tool reached GA as computer-use-2026-04-01 with stable display, mouse, keyboard, and clipboard primitives, plus a documented sandbox profile and a verified screenshot streaming mode.

title: Claude Managed Agents public beta
description: Managed Agents launched in public beta providing secure sandboxed execution, long-running sessions, scoped permissions, and end-to-end tracing at $0.08/runtime hour. All endpoints require the managed-agents-2026-04-01 beta header.

title: ant CLI for the Claude API
description: Anthropic shipped the ant CLI — a command-line client for the Claude API with native Claude Code integration and YAML-based versioning of API resources.

title: Sonnet 4 and Opus 4 deprecation announced
description: Anthropic announced the deprecation of claude-sonnet-4-20250514 and claude-opus-4-20250514, with retirement on the Claude API scheduled for June 15, 2026. Recommended migrations are Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Claude Opus 4.7 respectively.

title: Claude Opus 4.7 available on the Claude API
description: Opus 4.7 is available as claude-opus-4-7 at the same $5/$25 per MTok pricing as Opus 4.6, with API breaking changes versus Opus 4.6 (see the migration guide before upgrading) and an updated tokenizer that may map inputs to roughly 1.0–1.35× more tokens.

title: Claude Haiku 3 retired on the Claude API
description: claude-3-haiku-20240307 is now retired on the Claude API and returns errors. Migrate to Claude Haiku 4.5 for a near-frontier, lower-cost replacement; the deprecation was pre-announced on February 19, 2026.

title: Memory for Claude Managed Agents enters public beta
description: Claude Managed Agents now support persistent memory across sessions in public beta under the standard managed-agents-2026-04-01 beta header, with a documented integration guide at /docs/en/managed-agents/memory.

title: Rate Limits API released
description: Claude Platform released a Rate Limits API so administrators can programmatically query rate limits configured for their organization and workspaces.

title: Claude API webhooks GA
description: Claude Platform promoted event webhooks to general availability with signed delivery, replay protection, and retry tooling.

title: 1M context beta retired for older Claude 4 models
description: The context-1m-2025-08-07 beta header no longer extends Claude Sonnet 4.5 or Sonnet 4 beyond the standard 200k-token context window; migrate 1M-context workloads to Claude Sonnet 4.6 or Claude Opus 4.6.

title: Claude Managed Agents GA
description: Claude Managed Agents reached GA with a stable /v1/agents surface, runtime-hour pricing at $0.06/hour, named subagents, durable memory, and a SOC 2 Type II attestation for the hosted runtime.

title: Skills marketplace API
description: Claude Platform exposed the Skills marketplace through /v1/skills with discovery, install, version-pinning, and per-org allow-listing, behind the skills-marketplace-2026-05-01 beta header.

title: EU region for the Claude API
description: The Claude API added a dedicated EU region (api-eu.anthropic.com) for stored prompts, files, embeddings, and managed-agent runtimes, with regionally pinned inference for Sonnet 4.6, Opus 4.6, and Opus 4.7.
